title: mentha arvensis var. distans
intro: Mentha arvensis var. distans, commonly known as wild Japanese mint, is a variety of the peppermint plant native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues, headaches, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis var. distans include its ability to reduce nausea and vomiting, relieve anxiety and stress, and provide pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and isomenthone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
